observations: Red LPG gas cylinder shown close-up, sitting on a patterned mat indoors.
Brand name 'AMAZE' printed in white on the cylinder body (photo 0).
A small circular certification stamp is visible below the brand name but text is too small/blurry to read.
Brass valve/regulator fitting visible on top of the cylinder.
Visible rust and paint chipping on the carrying handle and near the base.
No burner (cooker top) or 'sitter' (stand/base unit) is visible anywhere in the photo — only the cylinder itself is shown.
Image has a 'POSTED ON JIJI' watermark and uploader name overlay, not seller-applied markings on the item.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows rust spots near the base and chipped/worn paint on the handle, not a clean/pristine finish.
Only the cylinder is visible in photo 0; no stand (sitter) or burner/cooker top is shown in any photo.

risks.risk: Burner and sitter may not actually be included, or may be in poor condition
risks.proof: A photo showing the cylinder together with the burner and sitter/stand, with both visible as a set
risks.if_unproven: priced as cylinder only, without burner or sitter

risks.risk: Cylinder may be past its safety recertification/expiry date (common requirement for LPG cylinders)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped manufacture/test date ring near the valve collar
risks.if_unproven: priced as expired/unverified certification, lowering resale confidence

risks.risk: Valve or cylinder body could be leaking or corroded internally, not detectable from a photo
risks.proof: A video clip showing the valve being turned and a leak/soap-bubble test, or a working regulator attached
risks.if_unproven: priced as not verified working, worst case treated as faulty valve

risks.risk: Rust at the base/handle could indicate thinning metal or structural weakness
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the base and handle from multiple angles under good light
risks.if_unproven: priced accounting for cosmetic and possible structural wear

proof_requests: Photo showing the burner and sitter/stand together with the cylinder
Close-up of the certification/test date stamp on the cylinder collar
Video of the valve/regulator being connected and tested for leaks
Additional photos of the cylinder base and handle in better lighting
response.reason: The seller claims a cylinder-plus-burner-plus-sitter set, but only the bare cylinder is shown in the single photo, and condition/certification details needed to price even a worst case are not visible.
